<!--
  The loading state of a page: grey blocks in the shape of the content that is coming (cards, a list of rows or
  an article). Axes: shape (cards, list, article), tone. The label tells assistive technology that the content
  is loading. The shimmer itself belongs to the Skeleton part.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Line } from "./skeleton-layout.types";

  export type SkeletonLayoutProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    label: string;
    lines: Line[];
    shape?: "cards" | "list" | "article";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Skeleton from "../primitives/skeleton/skeleton.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let { id, title, label, lines, shape = "cards", tone = "default" }: SkeletonLayoutProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density="default">
  <Block tag="div" class="w-full" role="status" aria-label={label} data-testid="skeleton" data-shape={shape}>
    {#if ((shape as string) === "cards")}
      <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4">
        {#each lines as l (l.id)}
          <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="item">
            <Skeleton class="aspect-video w-full" />
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-2/3" />
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    {:else if ((shape as string) === "list")}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        {#each lines as l (l.id)}
          <Group gap="4" align="center" data-testid="item">
            <Skeleton class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
            <Stack gap="2" class="flex-1">
              <Skeleton class="h-4 w-1/3" />
              <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {:else}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
        <Skeleton class="h-8 w-3/4" />
        {#each lines as l (l.id)}
          <Stack gap="2" data-testid="item">
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-5/6" />
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Block>
</SectionFrame>
